facts.statement: Besu advisory GHSA-hhgq-3gvc-4jhp, published 2026-11-10 with Moderate severity, lists versions <= 26.10.1 as affected and 26.10.2 as patched. It makes no consensus-split or safety claim and says IBFT does not share the second ordering defect.

Confirm that the deployed consensus algorithm is QBFT.
Confirm relevant devp2p access, ability to obtain the required signed message and peering exposure.
Trusted-node peering can reduce exposure; the advisory lists no workaround and identifies a patched release.
Private Besu integration does not reveal version, consensus algorithm or peering configuration.
This is a vendor advisory, not evidence of an incident or outage at DTCC.
facts.change_reason: Kept supported advisory metadata and conditional mapping; narrowed the IBFT distinction to the second ordering defect and distinguished exposure reduction from a workaround.

facts.quote: A current validator can stop block production in the stated four-validator, London-only, zeroBaseFee IBFT configuration.
facts.statement: A moderate-severity advisory (GHSA-6pcq-hcgg-5q76) published 2026-11-10 describes an IBFT 2.0 availability vulnerability in Hyperledger Besu versions <= 26.10.1, fixed in 26.10.2. The advisory lists no known CVE. The vulnerability allows a Byzantine current validator to halt block production in a four-validator, London-only, zeroBaseFee IBFT configuration. The advisory explicitly limits its impact claim to that specific configuration and does not claim permanence, a same-height fork, fund impact, or QBFT impact.
applicability_conditions: Confirm the DTCC private Besu version is affected (the advisory lists <= 26.10.1).
Confirm that the deployed consensus algorithm is IBFT 2.0.
Confirm the stated four-validator, London-only, zeroBaseFee configuration and the malicious-current-validator precondition.
Do not generalize the demonstrated effect to default fee-market configurations, QBFT, permanence, a fork or fund losses.
The public launch source does not disclose DTCC version, consensus algorithm, validator count or fee-market configuration.
This is a vendor advisory, not evidence of an incident or outage at DTCC.
facts.change_reason: Replaced the over-20-word quote with an exact 15-word impact sentence and restored the four-validator and malicious-validator preconditions. Replaced the categorical CVE-assignment claim with the source’s narrower no-known-CVE wording.
facts.evidence_quote: A current validator can stop block production in the stated four-validator, London-only, zeroBaseFee IBFT configuration.

facts.quote: This letter is withdrawn without further action three years from the date DTC launches operation of the Preliminary Base Version
facts.statement: The 2025-12-11 SEC staff letter states that the letter is withdrawn without further action three years after DTC launches operation of the Preliminary Base Version, with written notice at launch. The response concerns staff enforcement discretion and may be modified or revoked; it is not Commission approval.
applicability_conditions: Confirm the actual Preliminary Base Version operational launch and written notice before calculating a calendar expiry.
Do not assume that the 2026-10-28 public DTS launch announcement identifies that regulatory clock start.
The AWS input used selected material from the first 11 pages of the full 39-page PDF; additional request details are outside that excerpt.
The staff position is conditional on the stated facts and circumstances and may be modified or revoked.
facts.change_reason: Retained the supported three-year trigger; removed the unsupported inferred 2029-10-28 expiry date and clarified revocation and notice conditions.
facts.evidence_quote: This letter is withdrawn without further action three years from the date DTC launches operation of the Preliminary Base Version

facts.statement: The staff letter describes DTC management providing quarterly reporting to Division staff no later than the third Friday following each quarter-end. The package includes participation, tokenization, transfer, de-tokenization, wallet, blockchain, reversal and unavailability information.
applicability_conditions: This reporting is to SEC Division staff, with subsequent delivery to the DTCC board.
The stated regulatory reporting obligation does not establish public availability of the quarterly package.
Any voluntarily published operating metrics require separate collection and source verification.
facts.change_reason: Replaced a long nonmatching quote with the exact 11-word deadline; preserved regulatory reporting versus public data availability distinction.
facts.evidence_quote: no later than the third Friday following each quarter’s end date

facts.quote: LedgerScan’s record would constitute DTC’s official books and records.
facts.statement: The staff letter describes LedgerScan as an off-chain cloud system recording token movements and registered-wallet holdings in near real time; its record would constitute DTC’s official books and records. It describes Tier 2-or-better LedgerScan and Factory commitments, including primary/secondary operation, a maximum four-hour recovery time objective, at most two minutes of outage data loss, and annual out-of-region recovery testing.
applicability_conditions: These are described design and control commitments, not observed achievement of recovery or data-loss targets.
Public statements of targets must not be converted into measured DAS internal vulnerability values.
Actual incident, recovery-test and performance records would be needed to evaluate operating effectiveness.
facts.change_reason: Corrected the quote to the exact source subject (LedgerScan’s record) and separated public commitments from measured performance.
facts.evidence_quote: LedgerScan’s record would constitute DTC’s official books and records.

facts.quote: Eligible Securities: limited to (i) securities in the Russell 1000 Index
facts.statement: The described eligibility scope covers Russell 1000 securities at Preliminary Base Version launch plus later additions, notwithstanding subsequent index removals; U.S. Treasury bills, bonds and notes; and ETFs tracking major indices. DTC would assign tokenized entitlements no collateral or settlement value for its Net Debit Cap and Collateral Monitor calculations.
applicability_conditions: Subsequent removal from the Russell 1000 is not an automatic exclusion under the quoted eligibility description.
Check later DTCC and SEC materials before asserting changed eligibility, expanded functionality or a required filing.
The zero collateral/settlement-value restriction concerns the stated DTC risk calculations; do not infer CCP collateral use or measured loss protection.
facts.change_reason: Replaced an ellipsis-containing long quote with an exact 11-word excerpt; corrected the API’s mistaken exclusion of subsequent Russell 1000 removals and removed a blanket future-filing claim.
facts.evidence_quote: Eligible Securities: limited to (i) securities in the Russell 1000 Index
